extracted.intended_audience: general public, researchers, students, and policymakers needing country reference data
extracted.subtask_description: Structured country profile entries (background, geography, people, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, transnational issues) like a factbook reference. Each entry lists standard headings and statistical indicators for a country or territory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction / Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative background summarizing historical and recent political/economic developments (e.g., independence, major political events, governance changes, recent reforms, notable treaties or international agreements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides concise historical context and recent developments affecting the country's status (examples include periods of rule, accession to WTO, peace treaties, reforms enacted by current leaders).

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography (location, coordinates, map references, area, comparative)
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic location (region), geographic coordinates, map references, total area, water/land breakdown, and area comparisons (e.g., 'about 4.7 times the size of The Mall in Washington, DC').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes precise coordinates and simple comparative notes to convey scale to readers; lists land boundaries and coastline length when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime claims and coastal/territorial waters
rubrics_metrics.description: Maritime claims such as territorial sea, exclusive economic zone (EEZ), and continental shelf where applicable (e.g., territorial sea: 12 nm; EEZ: 200 nm).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies nautical claims relevant to maritime jurisdiction and resource rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate, terrain, elevation extremes, and natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: Climate classification/summary, predominant terrain, lowest and highest elevation points, and noted natural hazards (droughts, cyclones, earthquakes, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes environmental conditions and hazard risks that characterize the country's physical geography.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural resources and land use
rubrics_metrics.description: Major natural resources (e.g., phosphates, guano, petroleum, minerals) and land use breakdown (arable land, permanent crops, other), including irrigated land figures where available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exploited resources and percentage land allocation; may include short comments (e.g., 'guano deposits worked until depletion about 1890').

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - current issues and international agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Key environmental problems (pollution, water scarcity, desertification, radioactive/toxic sites) and list of international environmental agreements the country is party to or has signed but not ratified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a brief statement of pressing environmental concerns and participation status in conventions (e.g., Climate Change, Biodiversity, Law of the Sea).

rubrics_metrics.name: Population and demographic structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Total population and demographic breakdown including age structure (0-14, 15-64, 65+), median age, population growth rate, birth rate, death rate, net migration rate, sex ratio by age groups, and notes on indigenous or non-indigenous populations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presents core population statistics and notable population composition notes (e.g., presence/absence of indigenous inhabitants, historical personnel levels for territories).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vital statistics and health indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Infant mortality rate, life expectancy at birth (total/male/female), total fertility rate, and HIV/AIDS adult prevalence, number living with HIV/AIDS, and deaths where provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes health-focused indicators that inform public health and development assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality, ethnic groups, religions, languages, literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Nationality nomenclature, major ethnic group percentages, religious composition, official and widely used languages, and literacy rates (definition: age 15 and over can read and write).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives social and cultural composition metrics; literacy often broken down by sex.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government and political structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Country name variants, government type, dependency/administration status (for territories), capital, administrative divisions, independence date, constitution date, legal system, suffrage age and universality, and basic descriptions of executive, legislative, and judicial branches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outlines formal political institutions, recent changes (e.g., moves of capital), and electoral notes (e.g., reserved seats, election history).

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties, pressure groups, and political notes
rubrics_metrics.description: List of political parties and key leaders, political pressure groups and leaders, and pertinent notes about political dynamics (e.g., role of monarch, party legalization history).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies major organized political actors and contextual details about party/electoral systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerated list of international organizations the country participates in or observes (e.g., UN agencies, regional development banks, trade organizations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows global and regional institutional affiliations (often given as acronyms).

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Diplomatic representation to and from key partners (example: diplomatic representation in the US, chief of mission, chancery address, telephone/FAX) and notes on embassies/consulates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes contact details when available and notes on vacancies or Chargé d'Affaires.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed verbal description of the national flag, its colors, symbols, and the symbolic meaning of elements (e.g., star points representing principles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains symbolism and historical reference for the flag's design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - overview and macro indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative economy overview plus key macro indicators: GDP (PPP), GDP real growth rate, GDP per capita, GDP composition by sector (agriculture, industry, services), investment (gross fixed), population below poverty line, income distribution and Gini index, inflation rate, labor force size, labor force by occupation, unemployment rate, budget revenues and expenditures, and public debt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both narrative context (e.g., resource constraints, reforms) and quantitative fiscal/economic indicators with years/estimates noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sectoral production and resources (agriculture, industry, energy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Major agricultural products, principal industries (e.g., phosphate mining, tourism, dairy), industrial production growth rate, electricity production/consumption/imports/exports, oil and natural gas production/consumption/exports/imports and proved reserves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists sectors and energy statistics important for assessing production capacity and resource dependence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade (exports, imports, partners, commodities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Values and descriptions of exports and imports, lists of principal commodities exported/imported, and primary trade partners by percent or rank.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides trade profile including leading commodities and top partner countries (example: Exports - partners: US 21.5%, Iraq 17.6%).

rubrics_metrics.name: External finance and reserves (reserves, external debt, aid)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reserves of foreign exchange & gold, external debt figures, and economic aid statistics (e.g., ODA amounts or notes on being an aid recipient).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives indicators of external financial position and dependence on foreign aid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency and exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Official currency name and code, notes on currency relationships (e.g., Jersey pound at par with British pound), and historical exchange rates per US dollar for a sequence of years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include local currency peculiarities (e.g., use of another country's currency) and sample annual exchange rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and media
rubrics_metrics.description: Telephones (main lines in use, mobile cellular), telephone system assessment and details (domestic/international links), radio and television broadcast stations, numbers of radios/televisions, internet country code, internet hosts, ISPs, and internet users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines infrastructure counts with qualitative assessments of service and international connectivity; may list submarine cables or satellite earth stations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Railways (total and gauge), highways (total, paved/unpaved), pipelines (gas/oil lengths), ports and harbors, merchant marine, airports (total and runways by length), and heliports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantifies major transport networks and facilities, including notable ports and airport runway categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military (organization, manpower, expenditures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes on military branches, defense responsibilities (e.g., defense assumed by another country), military manpower statistics (age ranges, availability, fit for service), conscription status, and military expenditures (absolute and percent of GDP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both organizational notes (e.g., branches) and manpower/expenditure metrics; territories often note defense responsibility by another state.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational issues (disputes, refugees/IDPs)
rubrics_metrics.description: International disputes or claims, refugees by origin and internally displaced persons figures where applicable, and other cross-border issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes outstanding international claims and humanitarian displacement statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative / metadata (last updated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Page metadata such as 'This page was last updated on [date]' indicating currency of the information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as an explicit timestamp for the data and narrative provided (example: last updated on 10 February, 2005).
